# SeamlessHR Documentation

> Documentation for SeamlessHR

## API Reference: Overview
- [Introduction](https://docs.seamlesshr.com/reference/introduction.md)
- [API Structure](https://docs.seamlesshr.com/reference/api-structure.md): Breakdown of the various SeamlessHR Products, their base endpoints and description
- [Authentication](https://docs.seamlesshr.com/reference/authentication.md): A simple guide to authenticating your SeamlessHR API request
- [Standard HTTP Responses](https://docs.seamlesshr.com/reference/http-codes.md): SeamlessHR employs standard HTTP response codes to signify the success or failure of an API request.

## API Reference: Guides
- [Single Sign On (SSO)](https://docs.seamlesshr.com/reference/single-sign-on-sso.md)
  - [OpenID Connect (OIDC)](https://docs.seamlesshr.com/reference/google-workspace.md)
    - [Office 365](https://docs.seamlesshr.com/reference/office-365.md): Office 365 SSO enables easy authentication for SeamlessHR through Microsoft 365 accounts. This streamlines access while ensuring centralized control over user permissions.
    - [Google](https://docs.seamlesshr.com/reference/google.md): Google SSO (Single Sign-On) enables users to log in to SeamlessHR with their Google accounts, streamlining the authentication process securely. It offers a convenient and centralized access control…
    - [Zoho](https://docs.seamlesshr.com/reference/zoho-1.md)
  - [SAML](https://docs.seamlesshr.com/reference/saml.md)
    - [Azure AD](https://docs.seamlesshr.com/reference/azure-ad.md)
    - [OneLogin](https://docs.seamlesshr.com/reference/onelogin.md)
    - [Okta](https://docs.seamlesshr.com/reference/okta.md)
    - [Google ](https://docs.seamlesshr.com/reference/google-saml.md)
- [Employee Data Synchronisation](https://docs.seamlesshr.com/reference/employee-data-synchronisation.md)
  - [Connecting with Azure AD](https://docs.seamlesshr.com/reference/connecting-with-azure-ad.md)
  - [Webhook](https://docs.seamlesshr.com/reference/webhook.md)
